en: *Hetusampayuttaduka* (The Pair on Being Conjoined with Roots).
Dependent on a state associated with a root, a state not associated with a root arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with a root, a state dissociated from a root arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with a root, states both not associated with a root and dissociated from a root arise by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state dissociated from root-cause, a state dissociated from root-cause arises by way of root-cause condition.
Dependent on a state dissociated from root-cause, a state associated with root-cause arises by way of root-cause condition.
Dependent on a state dissociated from root-cause, states both associated with root-cause and dissociated from root-cause arise by way of root-cause condition.
Dependent on a state that is both associated with a root and dissociated from a root, there arises a state not associated with a root by way of the root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is both associated with a root and dissociated from a root, there arises a state dissociated from a root by way of the root-condition. Dependent on a state that is both associated with a root and dissociated from a root...
States that are neither associated with the root nor dissociated from the root arise by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of the root;

six in the case of the object; five in the case of the predominance … [and so on] … nine in the case of non-disappearance. (The "Conascent Chapter" … and the "Investigation Chapter" should also be expanded in detail.)
